summary: John's 7th-great-grandfather; Huguenot-descended New Yorker and DAR-recognized Revolutionary patriot (private, prisoner of war) of Monroe, Orange County.
bio: Jean (John) Lamoreaux was born in New York City in 1723, son of Daniel Lamoureux and Jeanne Masse and grandson of the Huguenot immigrant André Lamoureux; the tree shows 'Jean (John) Lomereaux 1723-1809'. He married Charity Davenport, daughter of Capt. Thomas Davenport, who in 1752 deeded Goshen-precinct land to 'Charity Lamoree, wife of John Lamoree', next to her brother Oliver Davenport. The 1919 Lamoureux Record remembers his wife as 'Charity Danforth' - not a conflict, since 'Danforth's' was the local rendering of 'Davenport's'. He is DAR ancestor A068227 (private; signed the Articles of Association; prisoner of war). His son John was captured at Fort Montgomery in Oct 1777. He died at Monroe on 28 Nov 1809; his 1809 Orange Co. will has not been seen. Descendants spread to Pennsylvania, Utah and Arizona.
